results.question: 每个区域清运量最大的那辆车分别是谁
results.sql:
WITH vehicle_region AS (
  SELECT r.region_name, v.plate_number, SUM(rm.total_weight) AS total_weight
  FROM t_route_manifest rm
  JOIN t_vehicle v ON rm.vehicle_id = v.id
  JOIN t_region r ON rm.region_id = r.id
  GROUP BY r.region_name, v.plate_number
)
SELECT DISTINCT ON (region_name) region_name AS 区域, plate_number AS 车牌号, total_weight AS 总清运量_kg
FROM vehicle_region
ORDER BY region_name, total_weight DESC
LIMIT 1000

results.question: 这个月既有超速预警、清运量又排前 5 的车
results.sql:
WITH monthly_weight AS (
  SELECT vehicle_id, SUM(total_weight) AS total_weight
  FROM t_route_manifest
  WHERE route_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
  GROUP BY vehicle_id
),
speeding_vehicles AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id
  FROM t_alert
  WHERE alert_type = '超速'
    AND alert_time >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
)
SELECT v.plate_number AS 车牌号, mw.total_weight AS 总清运量_kg
FROM monthly_weight mw
JOIN speeding_vehicles sv ON mw.vehicle_id = sv.vehicle_id
JOIN t_vehicle v ON mw.vehicle_id = v.id
ORDER BY mw.total_weight DESC
LIMIT 5
